newsitem.title: UK: Med oil products up $1-$2 on IPE, NYMEX gains.
newsitem.headline: Med oil products up $1-$2 on IPE, NYMEX gains.

text.p: Med oil products gained $1-$2 across the board on Tuesday, mainly on the back of higher screen levels, dealers said.
Gas oil firmed by about $2 a tonne across the board. September IPE gained $2.25 a tonne to close at $172.00, up $2.25 a tonne.

Trade remained in the depths of a summer lull, but traders said a French oil company bought a cargo of Russian heating oil on Tuesday or Monday evening at about a $1 premium over cif high Med quotations cif Genoa.
A British major bought another Russian heating oil cargo at 50 cents, around unchanged, over the cif high Med quotations cif Genoa.
Low sulphur diesel was still on offer at around $1.50 cif Lavera over the front month September IPE contract for Aug 25-Sept 5 delivery. Libyan was offered at a $1 premium to cif high Med quotes.
Buying interest remains in abeyance. "The market is experiencing the holiday mood," a trader said.

High sulphur fuel oil cargoes were quiet, but levels were stronger following a trade at a good number late on Monday, when a refiner sold a 25,000-tonne cargo of cracked material to a trader at high fob Med +$1.

The cargo may carry an additional charge of 40 cents per tonne as a co-loading fee as it has the option to coload with the buyer's 50,000 tonnes of fuel under a term contract to be supplied by the refiner.
There was a big possibility that the combined 75,000-tonne shipment may go into Romania, traders said.
They saw the market rising soon, with one saying there is strong interest in cargoes for fuel in September on a fob high +$1.25 basis.
